author: Karl Rock
description:
The script of Mohenjo-daro remains one of history’s greatest puzzles. Even with five thousand years of hindsight, scholars and linguists have yet to fully crack the code behind these 417 mysterious characters. 

While experts continue to search for the key to deciphering it, the symbols themselves offer a fascinating glimpse into a lost civilization. Some interpretations suggest these markings depict life in the Indus Valley, showing everything from fortified structures and housing layouts to depictions of fish and tools used for hunting.

This specific carving connects directly to a seven-inch limestone statue often referred to as the King of Mohenjo-daro. It is a haunting reminder of a complex society that thrived long ago, leaving behind a legacy that still keeps us guessing.
title: Can you solve this ancient mystery?

author: Karl Rock
description:
I’m standing in the exact spot where one of the most famous photos of Mohenjo-daro was taken… and that same image is printed on Pakistan’s 20 rupee note.

More than 4,000 years of history, right here in Sindh.
title: Ever looked closely at your cash?
